bullets.text: Sovereign Cloud Expansion - **Microsoft** enhances its Sovereign Cloud with new capabilities for secure AI operations, even offline.
Asha Sharma Takes Charge - **Microsoft** appoints Asha Sharma as EVP and CEO of **Microsoft Gaming**, marking a new leadership era.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - New **Windows 11** Insider Preview builds released, enhancing features and user experience.
Carbon Negative Milestone - **Microsoft** achieves its goal of matching 100% of global electricity consumption with renewable energy by 2025.
Budget Bytes Initiative - **Microsoft** launches Budget Bytes, empowering developers to create AI apps affordably on **Azure**.
